title: The Rail-Breaking Method
summary: Teaches four plain strikes and two qi-driven blows that crack a raised guard from the direction it does not watch.

title: Notes on the Qi-Struck Handle
summary: Gathers five plain handle drills and two qi-struck blows whose shock rings back up the opponent's weapon arm.

title: The Pinning Arm Handbook
summary: A handbook of six plain pins and presses and two qi-weighted holds for students who like to trap before they strike.

title: Treatise on the Hooked Long Arm
summary: Explains how the long arm hooks wrists and collars and ends with two qi-backed draws that tear a stance open.

title: A Manual of Baton in Each Hand
summary: Teaches students to carry a tonfa in each hand with six plain drills and three qi-charged combined strokes.

title: Lessons in the Rolling Block
summary: Seven lessons on turning the long arm over the forearm to take blows and return them with qi behind the roll.

title: Handbook of the Joint-Locking Baton
summary: Sets out six plain wrist and elbow locks and two qi-set locks that hold a limb against its natural bend.

title: Close Guard and Counter Spin
summary: A short treatise of four plain guard moves and two qi-spun counters for fighting inside the length of the weapon.
